title: MicroAssert: Microarchitecture-Aware Structured Assertion Generation for CPU Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.24872v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic assertion generation reduces manual verification effort, yet existing approaches struggle to capture microarchitectural behaviors and cross-region interactions in CPUs. We present MicroAssert, a microarchitecture-aware framework that identifies functional regions directly from RTL and generates local and composite assertions through structured contracts and deterministic verification primitives. Coverage-guided feedback further improves verification completeness by progressively expanding proof-relevant RTL coverage. Evaluated on five open-source RISC-V CPUs against three existing assertion generation approaches, MicroAssert achieves 100% syntax correctness and complete branch, statement, and toggle coverage, with an average proven rate of 74.82% and Proof Core coverage of 90.96%. translated_title: MicroAssert：面向CPU验证的微架构感知结构化断言生成
translated_abstract: 自动断言生成减少了人工验证的工作量，但现有方法难以捕捉CPU中的微架构行为和跨区域交互。我们提出了MicroAssert，这是一个微架构感知的框架，它直接从RTL中识别功能区域，并通过结构化契约和确定性验证原语生成局部及复合断言。覆盖率引导的反馈通过逐步扩展与证明相关的RTL覆盖率，进一步提升了验证完整性。在五个开源RISC-V CPU上与三种现有断言生成方法进行对比评估，MicroAssert实现了100%的语法正确性以及完全的分支、语句和翻转覆盖率，平均证明率达到74.82%，Proof Core覆盖率达到90.96%。变异测试进一步展示了其优势，平均错误检测率达到28.73%，比现有方法高出1.99至3.51倍。
tldr: MicroAssert是一个微架构感知的结构化断言自动生成框架，通过从RTL识别功能区域并生成局部与复合断言，在五个开源RISC-V CPU上实现了100%语法正确率和74.82%的平均证明率，错误检测率较现有方法提升1.99至3.51倍。
en_tdlr: MicroAssert is a microarchitecture-aware structured assertion generation framework that identifies functional regions from RTL to generate local and composite assertions, achieving 100% syntax correctness, 74.82% average proven rate, and 1.99-3.51x higher error detection rates than existing methods across five open-source RISC-V CPUs.
